name: Nintedanib Esylate

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS • Hepatic impairment: Nintedanib capsules are not recommended for use in patients with moderate or severe hepatic impairment. In patients with mild hepatic impairment (Child Pugh A), the recommended dosage is 100 mg twice daily approximately 12 hours apart taken with food. Consider treatment…

summary: Official warnings state that this drug is not recommended for people with moderate or severe liver damage, also known as hepatic impairment, while those with mild liver damage require a specific lower dose taken with food [3]. Additionally, a small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave this medicine a medium score of 62 for liver concerns and a low score of 34 for heart concerns [M]. Several clinical studies were stopped early because of recruitment difficulties, the COVID-19 pandemic, low enrollment, or lack of drug availability [5][6][7].
